title: Tunisian Corn Pastry
description: A traditional German dessert with a Tunisian twist, featuring flaky pastries and a sweet corn filling.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the Tunisian corn, granulated sugar, and egg.
Add in the yellowed butter, vanilla extract, and salt. Mix until well combined.
Roll out the flaky pastries and cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of the corn mixture onto each pastry circle.
Fold the pastry in half to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the pastries on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastries are golden brown.
